meta.name: experimentation
meta.description: Designs, runs, and reads A/B tests and growth experiments — hypothesis, sample size, duration, and honest interpretation. Use this to plan a test, judge whether a result is real, build an experimentation program, decide what to test next, or diagnose why tests keep producing inconclusive or non-replicating results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并解读A/B测试,让增长决策有据可依
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做增长,经常需要验证新想法是否有效
copy.tagline_en: Design and interpret A/B tests to make data-driven growth decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in growth and need to validate which version works better

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会帮你按规范做A/B测试:先定带机制的假设和唯一主要指标,提前算好样本量和测试时长;测试中提醒不中途偷看;到期后解读显著性、检查护栏并记录日志。
howto.when: 当你要求规划A/B测试、判断结果是否真实,或诊断测试为何总是没有结论时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我设计A/B测试:价格表移到首屏能提高试用转化,样本量怎么算?
say.note: 它会要求你写清假设机制和唯一指标,并计算样本量。

say.text: 这个实验结果显著吗?现在能下结论了吗?
say.note: 它会先确认是否到预定时间和有无偷看,再看显著性与护栏。

say.text: 为什么我们最近几个测试都没有结论?帮我诊断。
say.note: 它会检查样本量、时长、中途偷看等原因,给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows experimentation discipline to plan A/B tests: it asks for a mechanism-based hypothesis, one primary metric, and pre-computed sample size and duration; warns against peeking mid-flight; at the end interprets significance, checks guardrails, and keeps a test log.
howto.when_en: It activates when you ask to plan an A/B test, judge whether a result is real, or diagnose why tests keep producing inconclusive or non-replicating results.

say_en.text: Design an A/B test: moving pricing above the fold lifts trials. How to size?
say_en.note: It checks mechanism and metric, then computes sample size.

say_en.text: Is this experiment result significant? Can we conclude now?
say_en.note: It checks duration, peeking, and guardrails first.

say_en.text: Why have our recent tests been inconclusive? Diagnose it.
say_en.note: It checks sample size, duration, peeking; suggests fixes.
